verdict.rationale: Railway's marketing docs mention 'Run your application closer to where your users are' (railway-docs-7), implying multi-region deployment, but there is no documentation on selecting specific regions, listing available regions, or configuring region-based deployment, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this capability. Missing for 10: detailed region list/selection docs, technical configuration guidance, independent verification of region-based deployment working as described.
